units.source_text: 他想起今年春节那天，富森助右卫门喝了三杯屠苏酒就醉了。

en.t: He remembered New Year's Day that year, when Tomimori Sukeemon had become drunk after drinking only three cups of toso sake.

units.source_text: 他吟道：“今日又迎春，纵然闲睡心无愧，武士愿已偿。”

en.t: He recited, "Today I welcome spring once more; even if I sleep at leisure, my heart feels no shame, for a warrior's wish has already been fulfilled."

units.source_text: 这首俳意味深远，它的寓意与良雄现在志得意满的心情完美契合。

en.t: This haiku was deeply meaningful, and its implication perfectly matched Yoshio's present feeling of proud satisfaction.
